name: dv1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a friendly prehistoric valley like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO dinosaurs, NO animals and NO people: a warm pale yellow and blue sky, a small smoking volcano and rounded blue mountains far away, tall palm like cycad trees and giant ferns on the left and right edges, one very tall tree on the right with a big leafy top near the top of the picture, a calm blue lake in the middle distance, and a wide open flat sandy green plain across the bottom half of the picture with a few rocks.
